name: delta_root
physiological_meaning: Activation onset of the graph root (SA / atrial source) relative to the R peak; a global time origin for the whole activation sequence

name: edge_prox0
physiological_meaning: conduction delay on graph edge e0 (SA/atrium -> AV/His); carries the AV-nodal delay (PR-segment analogue)

name: edge_prox1
physiological_meaning: conduction delay on graph edge e1 (AV/His -> septum); His-Purkinje entry into the septum

name: edge_leaf0
physiological_meaning: conduction delay on graph edge e2 (septum -> RV); fascicular / branch delay to that ventricular wall

name: edge_leaf1
physiological_meaning: conduction delay on graph edge e3 (septum -> LV-ant); fascicular / branch delay to that ventricular wall

name: edge_leaf2
physiological_meaning: conduction delay on graph edge e4 (septum -> LV-lat); fascicular / branch delay to that ventricular wall

name: edge_leaf3
physiological_meaning: conduction delay on graph edge e5 (septum -> LV-inf); fascicular / branch delay to that ventricular wall

name: edge_leaf4
physiological_meaning: conduction delay on graph edge e6 (septum -> apex); fascicular / branch delay to that ventricular wall
